title: Bid for North Pier
summary: A locker company will pay forty dollars a share for North Pier Storage.

title: Bid for Lumen Glass
summary: A glazier will pay eighteen dollars a share for Lumen Glass.

title: Offer on Cedar Lane
summary: A cabinet maker will pay two thousand five hundred dollars for the Cedar Lane Studio.

title: Offer on Kiln and Clay
summary: A potter will pay six thousand dollars for Kiln and Clay, note and all.

title: Extra Mill Shift
summary: The brickworks adds a shift. Every player collects two hundred dollars.

title: Storm Week
summary: A week of storms. Every player pays one hundred fifty dollars for repairs.

title: Harbor Festival
summary: The harbor festival fills the stalls. Every player collects one hundred dollars.

title: Slip Fee
summary: The harbor raises the slip fee. Every player pays eighty dollars.

title: North Pier splits
summary: North Pier Storage splits two for one. Every holder doubles those shares.

title: Lumen Glass splits
summary: Lumen Glass splits two for one. Every holder doubles those shares.
